concepts.label: Index Service
concepts.reused_or_minted: reused - existing registry concept, minted in server/learn/services-and-indexes/services/index-service.json

notable_absence.finding: Pure reference catalog - a flat list of index_* Prometheus metric names (avg_disk_bps, avg_drain_rate, avg_item_size, avg_mutation_rate, avg_resident_percent, etc.), each with a version badge and one-line description. No prose about service dependencies, editions, or roles - unlike server/'s index-service.json (prior round), which stated the Index-Service-depends-on-Data-Service relationship in prose, this metrics catalog states nothing structural. See metrics-reference.json (this batch) for the consolidated dependsOnService finding.
